title: PhoenixSCinMC
description: Just Adds PhoenixSC into the Game
body:
This Mod adds an entity called Phoenix SC into the Game,His Powers are inspired  form a YouTuber with subscribers of  2.58+million, which can travel in the speed of  sound, it is impossible to defeat with vanilla weapons as he has health of 50 hearts, it shoots arrows on players rapidly
This mod is just made for fun


[I Hope PhoenixSC  See it and Trys the mod out]
